title: LLV-GQL225: quarter-log tables give degree9/4 classical space

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the one LLV-GQL225 configuration in proof.md recovers the entire secret with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. On EVERY branch charged work is O(2^((1/2)sqrt(n)log2(n)+(5/2)sqrt(n))), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. At n>=2^4096 compute v=floor sqrt n,ell=ceil log2n,lambda=ceil(ell/4),H_n=bit_length(n^1024-1),m=floor(4096*(v-256ell)/(4H_n+17408)),kappa=ceil log2(m+2)+3,A_bar=ceil((n+m*kappa)/(m*lambda))+2,H_A=bit_length(A_bar^1024-1),center=2(m-1),fan_i=A_bar+4i-center. Exact prefix capacity and final k=ceil((R+kappa+1)/lambda) handle every remainder, including u=m,R=0,1<=k<=3; lambda>=kappa is not assumed. Sections8,14 establish the exact source and every-level/finishing time bounds with internal exponent sqrt(n)log2(n)/2+(19/8+1/2048)sqrt(n)+o(sqrt n), strict gap255/2048 absorbing all polynomial cost. All source/LE, lookup/exclusion, generation, arithmetic, addresses, failures, measurements and cleanup are charged jointly with all other claims.

For this same LLV-GQL225 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak classical workspace is O(n^(9/4)) bits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. Quarter-log tables have 2^lambda=O(n^(1/4)); O(n) retained full-label tables each use O(n^(5/4)) bits. The single current tuple list uses O(n^(5/4)); input/sort/residue arrays use O(n^(7/4)). All source/LE, cap arithmetic, stack, streamed decoder and gate/address generation use O(n^2). No full tree, truth table or exponential circuit is stored. This holds jointly with full-secret success and every other claim.

For this same LLV-GQL225 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, peak quantum allocation is O(n) qubits with an absolute constant and exact growth index0. Pending vector siblings use O(lambda*sum_i fan_i)=O(n); the finish and current fresh search use O(fan_max*lambda)=O(sqrt(n)log n)<=O(n) scratch, reset/reused between trials. Source/LE, rank/projection, failures and abort cleanup are included. The exact centered sum gives m*A_bar*lambda<=n+m*kappa+3m*lambda. This holds jointly with unconditional full-secret success and the other claims.

For this same LLV-GQL225 configuration, every N,s and EVERY branch, all acquired source copies number O(2^((1/2)sqrt n)), with an absolute constant and exact growth index1/2. All failed, discarded, rejected and aborted requests count. Dbar=2K*lambda*fan_max*A_bar^m,Dcap=2^12nDbar,Ccap=2^13nDbar. Exact centered AM-GM bounds the full product and prefixes by A_bar^m, finishing through fan_max*A_bar^m, including the zero-width tail with 1<=k<=3. Section8 proves A_bar<=17sqrt(n)/4, log2(17/4)<21/10, m*H_A/1024<=(v-256ell)/2 and literal nCcap+K<=2^(v/2), including every polynomial cap factor. Finite lengths change outside constants. All claims hold jointly with unconditional full-secret success.

For the same LLV-GQL225 algorithm and configuration of proof.md, the proved fractional error tolerance is epsilon(n) = 0: all Q source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N and s, full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1 - 2^-8 jointly with all four resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted; this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
